pages.text: Place tables next to each other to join their tops and legs. Right-click the top with an item to display it, or click again to eject it. Filled maps show their terrain. Sneak-right-click the top to open the display slot.
Oak is shown here. Tables retain their wood or framed panel.

pages.title: Cloth and Carpet
pages.text: Right-click with carpet on top for a tablecloth or on the side for a floor rug. Drill the top to remove the cloth. Sneak-drill to remove the rug. Drill a horizontal face to turn the display on that axis.
